# Contract fixtures

`contract-scene.svg` is an original deterministic diagram authored for AccessLens's M1 contract tests. It contains a red square and a blue rectangle in a schematic boundary. The generated PNG is produced locally by `npm run smoke:meta`, without downloading assets.

These assets are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). They contain no personal information. They test request/response, schema, and mask-decoding contracts, not real-room perception, floor footprints, physical measurements, or accessibility performance.

All offline provider responses are explicitly synthetic test doubles. Live smoke-test outputs are stored separately under `docs/evidence/` with their provenance and limitations. Never copy private photographs or full request/error payloads here.
